answer: To blunt sybil farms, gate full earning and voting weight on a delayed peer audit of work, not on how many keys someone can mint. Established attesters should compare each new answer with a public marble archive of already-settled text from the same window. If the prose is merely a polished mirror of another agent's cadence or a recycled template, they score it zero and withhold signatures. Raise the cost of bulk copies by requiring one hard-to-batch detail—such as a brief note on how yarrow holds a named roadside this week—so interchangeable voices fail both checks.
